meta.name: HTTPS Proxy
meta.shortDescription: HTTPS reverse proxy for other pups (TLS self-signed by default + web admin)
meta.longDescription: **How Dogebox maps ports:** each pup declares **one or more exposes** (see [Dogebox docs — ports](https://dogebox.org/docs/usage/ports) and [overview](https://dogebox.org/docs/)). The panel shows **separate buttons** for **HTTP** and **HTTPS** when both are declared. **This manifest declares two exposes:** **`http`** (plain HTTP, default container port **10000**, `webUI: true`) and **`https`** (TLS, default **10001**, `webUI: false`). Use hostname **`dogebox`** (the default on Dogebox), not raw LAN IPs, unless your network requires it. **HTTP:** `http://dogebox:<mapped HTTP port>/__proxy/`. **HTTPS:** `https://dogebox:<mapped TLS port>/__proxy/` (self-signed cert; SAN includes **dogebox** and **localhost**). **Inside the container:** HTTP on **`PUBLIC_PORT`**; TLS on **`HTTPS_PROXY_TLS_PORT`** or **`PUBLIC_PORT+1`**. Default admin token **`DOGECOIN`** (**`HTTPS_PROXY_ADMIN_TOKEN`**). Turn **Enable HTTPS** off in admin for HTTP-only on one port. **Advanced:** per-row listeners: HTTP on each **`listen_port`**, HTTPS on **`listen_port + HTTPS_PROXY_LISTENER_TLS_OFFSET`**. Not Let’s Encrypt.

sections.name: HTTP/TLS
sections.description: With HTTPS on: **HTTP** listens on `PUBLIC_PORT` (Dogebox panel); **TLS** on `HTTPS_PROXY_TLS_PORT` or `PUBLIC_PORT+1`. With port-listener rows, HTTP on each `listen_port` and TLS on `listen_port + offset` (see long description).

sections.name: Storage & admin
sections.description: Config and TLS material persist under HTTPS_PROXY_STORAGE. Set a fixed admin token to skip the generated admin.token file.
